description: Frozen score-blind synthetic history-length scenarios on audited actual stores. Sources and restaurants overlap development; seeds are not independent users. Model tuning must not inspect these outcomes.

label_protocol.history_length: Distinct stores and distinct observed brands. Same current inputs across N. Fixed full history split into label-balanced blocks; last N suffix means older observations only are added as N grows. Prior inversions use same stores and opposite labels.
label_protocol.target_exclusion: Target food terms absent from menus, names, summaries and original Kakao/Naver reviews of prior pool. Strict no-keyword policy excludes even comparative mentions to avoid vector-level target signal.
label_protocol.heldout: All catalogue confirmed-food and strict-style stores except every current/past brand; groups have varying sizes reported per run.
label_protocol.recommendation_rate: A ranking/slate proportion under specified synthetic inputs, not click probability or measured human accuracy.
label_protocol.extended_probes: Single-class probes change the labels on four confirmed cutlet stores and are functional, not accuracy tests. Switch probes intentionally re-rate the same eight stores and are not pure target-food-free style transfer. Soft history retains20likes/20dislikes overall while weakening the style association to15/20vs5/20.

fixture_audit_correction.reason: Before scoring, exclude generic menu-only neutrals and audit every menu description. Exclude1733187185 explicit udon descriptions, leaving13strictJapanese brands and reducing noodle maximumN20to16 without padding.

limits: Cuisine is a scenario proxy for history, not an intrinsic taste axis.
No keyword evidence is bounded by collected source text and is not a guarantee of live menu absence.
Noodle N16 limit follows the13strictJapanese stores available for8past+4current negatives; N20/40/80 not fabricated.
No model import, prediction, score, vector or rank was used by this builder.
All-brand disjointness uses the observed serving brand_key mapping; undiscovered corporate/recipe relationships can remain.

metadata_audit_revision.reason: Replace inherited base counts/timelines with actual probe counts, phase-specific denominators, and explicit matched N0 control references.

notes: Single-class probes are functional edge cases, not an accuracy estimate.
Switch probes deliberately reuse the same eight stores with changed labels and preserve their real event times.
No new category rules or model tuning use the probe outcomes.
